core: Nuclear envelope and nuclear pore complex organization
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope and pore complex disassembly and reassembly
rationale: All members concern nuclear envelope, lamina and pore complex organization, dominated by their mitotic breakdown and reformation, which the transport/SUMOylation confusables lack and which goes beyond ESCRT-mediated sealing.

name: Glomerular podocyte and basement membrane development
rationale: Members describe podocyte migration, nephrin interactions, glomerular epithelial and basement membrane development, distinguishing this from confusables centred on mesangial, endothelial or tubular development.

qualifier: dietary carbohydrate digestion and intestinal absorption
name: Dietary carbohydrate digestion and hexose transmembrane transport
rationale: Members cover saccharide digestion and SLC2/SLC5-mediated hexose absorption and transport defects, unlike confusables focused on galactose/fructose catabolism or urate and amino acid transporters.

core: FGFR ligand activation and downstream signaling
name: FGFR1 and FGFR2 activation and downstream signaling cascades
rationale: Members are ligand binding, splicing, mutant activation and SHC/FRS/PLC/PI3K cascades of FGFR1 and FGFR2, whereas confusables carry FGFR3/FGFR4 and Klotho pathways.

name: Cholesterol uptake via LDL receptor endocytosis and degradation
rationale: Members span LDL/VLDL receptor internalization, lysosomal receptor degradation and SREBP-linked sterol control of cholesterol uptake, while confusables emphasize HDL formation and cholesterol efflux.

name: Fc-epsilon receptor-triggered mast cell activation and degranulation
rationale: All members describe FcERI signaling to calcium, MAPK and NF-kB leading to mast cell degranulation, histamine and cytokine release, unlike confusables on mast cell differentiation, Th2 cytokines or Fc-gamma receptors.

qualifier: RAS GTPase regulation by GEFs/GAPs and RAS pathway mutants
name: RAS GTPase regulation and oncogenic RAS-MAPK pathway mutants
rationale: Members centre on RAS activation by SOS, inactivation by GAPs/NF1, and RAS, MRAS-SHOC2 and MAP2K mutants signaling to RAF, distinguishing it from confusables on ERK feedback inactivation or BRAF/RAF1 mutants.

qualifier: proliferation, migration and oocyte meiotic maturation
name: Germ cell proliferation, migration and oocyte meiotic maturation
rationale: Members concern germ cell proliferation, migration and death, meiosis activation and oocyte maturation, whereas confusables involve testicular somatic cells, germline specification, follicle growth or sperm.

qualifier: hair follicles, skin glands and nails
name: Ectodermal appendage and hair follicle development
rationale: Members cover hair follicle, sebaceous and mammary gland, nail, papilla and melanocyte development from ectoderm, unlike confusables focused on keratinocyte differentiation, cornification or teeth.

qualifier: CCR2/CX3CR1 axis and negative regulation of leukocyte migration
name: CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte chemotaxis and its negative regulation
rationale: Members combine CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte trafficking modules with mostly negative regulation of chemokine signaling and leukocyte migration, whereas confusables carry positive monocyte chemotaxis, activation and chemokine binding.

core: Protein targeting to the endoplasmic reticulum
name: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein targeting to ER
rationale: Members describe co- and post-translational protein targeting, membrane insertion and retention in the ER, distinguishing it from confusables on COPII export and ER-associated degradation.

core: Transcriptional control of cell cycle arrest
qualifier: p53 and FOXO, G1 arrest and quiescence
name: p53- and FOXO-driven G1 arrest and quiescence entry
rationale: Members concern p53/FOXO regulation and transcription of cell cycle inhibitors such as p21 and G0/G1 transitions, unlike confusables on p53-driven apoptosis, p14ARF loss or retinoic acid signaling.

name: Arterial smooth muscle tone and vasoconstriction
rationale: All members concern contraction or relaxation of arterial smooth muscle and vasoconstriction, without the angiotensin, adrenoceptor-subtype or nitric oxide-cGMP pathways of the confusables.

name: Neurotrophin-3 signaling through TRKC and TRKB
rationale: Members are NTF3 activation of NTRK3 and NTRK2 and their PI3K, PLCG1 and RAS outputs, distinguishing it from confusables on BDNF/NTF4-TRKB or NGF-TRKA signaling.

name: Rac-driven ruffling, macropinocytosis and early endosome trafficking
rationale: Members link Rac signaling, ruffle and podosome assembly to macropinocytosis and early endosomal transport, unlike confusables on clathrin/caveolin endocytosis or Rho GTPase cycles.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport and potassium channel ion homeostasis
rationale: Members comprise SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters and their diseases, potassium channels and regulation of sodium transport, while confusables focus on osmotic stress, sodium/proton exchange or magnesium and paracellular transport.

name: Glucagon-PKA signaling controlling gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members describe glucagon response, PKA activation and AMPK/PKA phosphorylation regulating gluconeogenesis, unlike confusables on insulin sensitivity, glycogen metabolism, insulin secretion or lipolysis.

qualifier: postsynaptic ionotropic receptor activation and clustering
name: Postsynaptic ionotropic glutamate receptor signaling and clustering
rationale: Members cover NMDA, AMPA and kainate receptor activation, trafficking and clustering in excitatory transmission, distinguishing it from confusables on presynaptic modulation, CREB-linked memory or long-term plasticity.

qualifier: E2F transcription and pre-replicative complex assembly
name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and pre-replicative complex assembly
rationale: Members combine E2F target transcription with ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex formation and activation, unlike confusables on replication-stress checkpoints or broad cell cycle modules.

name: Peroxisomal fatty acid alpha- and beta-oxidation
rationale: Members describe peroxisomal oxidation of very-long-chain, branched and polyunsaturated fatty acids, unlike confusables on fatty acid elongation, plasmalogens or mitochondrial short/medium-chain catabolism.

name: Dicarboxylate, tricarboxylate and pyruvate organic anion transport
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated transport of succinate, alpha-ketoglutarate, citrate, pyruvate and related anions, while confusables carry the malate-aspartate shuttle, cationic amino acid, organic cation or carnitine transport.

name: Phosphate homeostasis and bone and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members link phosphate transport and parathyroid hormone response to mineralization of bone, dentin and enamel and to ectopic calcification, unlike confusables centred on FGF23-Klotho, type II Na/Pi cotransporters or chondrocytes.

name: Fructose, polyol and glucuronate-xylulose pentose metabolism
rationale: Members cover fructose catabolism, alditol metabolism and the glucuronate-xylulose pentose route with their inborn errors, distinguishing it from confusables on galactose catabolism and the pentose phosphate shunt.

name: Histone acetyltransferase and lysine methyltransferase complex activity
rationale: Members concern lysine acetylation of histones and other proteins and WDR5/KMT2 histone methylation complexes with their cofactors, unlike confusables on BAF/NuRD remodeling, DNA methylation, deacetylation or chromosome condensation.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuronal differentiation
qualifier: midbrain dopaminergic neurons and radial glia
name: Neural progenitor proliferation and midbrain dopaminergic neuron differentiation
rationale: Members concern neuroblast and radial glial proliferation and neuronal differentiation, notably midbrain dopaminergic neurons, unlike confusables on glial fate, neural stem cell maintenance or axon guidance.
